The '''JumpMaster 5000''',<ref name="TUR" /> also known as the '''JM-5000 Jumpmaster Long Range Scout''',<ref name="EdgeCore" /> or colloquially as simply the '''JM-5K''',<ref name="TUR" /> was a [[scout ship]] designed by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="HoD" /><ref name="EdgeCore" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Jumpmaster5000-tur.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A schematic of a stock JumpMaster]]
The JumpMaster was designed to be a small one-person vessel capable of long-range scouting and reconnaissance duties over lengthy amounts of time, allowing a single crew member to travel for extended periods in relative comfort, with limited room for other passengers.<ref name="TUR" /> Flat and crescent-shaped, the hull of the ship was packed with powerful and highly sensitive [[sensor]] systems that possessed incredible range.<ref name="EdgeCore" /> An off-set cylindrical fuselage housed the craft's spartan living quarters, cargo-hold, power generators, and drive system.<ref name="TUR" /> Relatively lightly armored, JumpMaster's relied on sheer speed and agility - coupled with their powerful sensors - to avoid trouble.<ref name="EdgeCore" />

While performing admirably in most regards, the JumpMaster was hobbled by a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] system that was both slow and prone to breakdowns. Owing to the versatility of a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC]] design, however, the craft was extremely modifiable; as a result the first modification done to the craft was often a faster and more reliable hyperdrive engine.<ref name="TUR" /> Beyond this, the craft was equipped with two hard points for modification,<ref name="EdgeCore" /> and could be substantially modified with vastly improved shields and significant increased firepower - as [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] did with the ''[[Punishing One]]''.<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
Designed during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the JumpMaster was mostly used to scout new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] and map newly discovered systems.<ref name="TUR" /> Indeed, their primary users were the [[Civilian Astrogation Corps/Legends|Civilian Astrogation Corps]], who used the craft to make sure navigation charts were up to date. That said, due to their speed and powerful sensors, it was not uncommon to find JumpMasters in planetary militias, serving as picket ships and early warning patrol craft.<ref name="EdgeCore" />

==Notable users==
[[File:Punishing_One_JKTCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Punishing One]], an infamous JumpMaster 5000]]
Perhaps the most infamous user of a JumpMaster was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], who flew a modified JumpMaster 5000 during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], named ''[[Punishing One]]''.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref> The Punishing One was substantially modified from stock, with [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] adding a [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]], an [[Ion cannon/Legends|Ion cannon]], and a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher in addition to a cutting-edge engine bay that drastically increased the ship's speed. Dengar further modified the ship so that an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] brain could independently operate the quad guns, allowing Dengar to fly the ship without having to worry about firing back.<ref name="HoD" />
